name: 98671 · Washougal, WA
findings: ZIP 98671 (Washougal) has 61 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98671 (Washougal) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98671 (Washougal) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98671 (Washougal) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
